arms.net-g3scratch: Baseline binary loading artifacts/gen3/nets/g3scratch/network.nnue through EvalFile, against the same binary with its embedded network.
arms.net-confirm: Series head d9d32a1 (new network embedded) against the baseline binary, 1,024 rounds from opening seed 31337 with no sequential stop.
arms.net-50ms: Series head d9d32a1 against the baseline binary at 50 ms per move through tools/run_sprt.py and the selfplay arbiter, 2,048 pairs from docs/tuning/data/selective-search-confirmation.epd.
arms.tm20: Baseline with DEFAULT_MOVES_TO_GO 15 -> 20 and the whole increment added to the soft budget instead of three quarters; embedded network.
arms.tm26: Baseline with DEFAULT_MOVES_TO_GO 15 -> 26 and the whole increment added to the soft budget; embedded network.
arms.tm15inc: Series head d9d32a1 (new network embedded) with only the increment share changed from three quarters to the whole increment, against d9d32a1.

interpretation.strength: Each arm is compared directly with its own baseline. The first network arm and the first two clock arms ran at the same time on the 96-logical-CPU host, 84 games at once; the later arms overlapped each other at up to 80 games at once. The 50 ms arm used the selfplay arbiter, its random-walk book and its own pair-normal interval, not fastchess.
interpretation.style: Forcing and check rates of engine-played moves only, excluding the sixteen book plies, with a bootstrap over complete colour-reversed rounds (4000 replicates, seed 14875), from analyze_pairs.py.
interpretation.intervals: Pair-normal Elo intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for sequential stopping; an arm stopped by the SPRT carries the usual upward bias of an early stop at H1.
interpretation.incomplete_pairs: After a verified normal SPRT stop, unmatched recorded rounds are listed and excluded from the paired estimates.

fixture_mining.corpus: artifacts/gen3/n20000 groups 78 and 79, the development split the network was not trained on
fixture_mining.sampling: every seventh row with |label score| <= 120, at least 18 pieces and the side to move not in check; unique by the first four FEN fields; shuffled with seed 29
fixture_mining.screen: Aggression 0 and 100 at 20,000 nodes with fresh tables (mine_fixtures.py); 6,000 positions in round 1 and 14,000 in round 2
fixture_mining.verification: the same move at 20,000, 40,000, 60,000 and 100,000 nodes for each profile, the two moves different, objective loss from Aggression 0 restricted to the Aggression 100 move at 20,000 and 100,000 nodes (verify_fixtures.py)
